units.source_text: 看样子，K的神经衰弱到这个时候已经好多了。

en.t: It seemed that K's nervous exhaustion had improved considerably by this time.

units.source_text: 相反地，我倒渐渐变得神经质了。

en.t: On the contrary, I myself was gradually becoming more nervous.

units.source_text: 看见K比我还沉稳，我既羡慕又嫉妒。

en.t: Seeing K calmer than I was, I felt both envy and jealousy.

units.source_text: 他总是摆出一副对我不理不睬的样子，在我看来，这似乎是一种自信。

en.t: He always behaved as though he had no interest in dealing with me, and to my eyes this seemed like a kind of confidence.

units.source_text: 即便在他脸上看到这种自信，我也绝不感到安心。

en.t: Even when I saw that confidence on his face, I did not feel at ease in the least.

units.source_text: 我的怀疑又加深了一步，想要弄明白他为什么自信。

en.t: My suspicions deepened another step, and I wanted to understand why he was so confident.

units.source_text: 莫非他对于自己的学业或事业，又重新看到了值得他为之奋斗的光明前途？

en.t: Could it be that, in his studies or career, he had once again glimpsed a bright future worth striving for?

units.source_text: 如果仅仅是这样的话，K当然不会同我发生什么利害冲突，我反而应该为自己对他的关照有了成果而感到欣喜。

en.t: If it was only that, then of course there would be no conflict of interest between K and me; on the contrary, I ought to have been pleased that my care for him had borne fruit.

units.source_text: 然而，倘若他的平静心态是因为小姐，我就绝不能原谅他了。

en.t: However, if his calm state of mind was because of the young lady, then I could never forgive him.

units.source_text: 奇怪的是，他好像丝毫没有觉察到我爱着小姐。

en.t: Strangely enough, he seemed not to have noticed at all that I loved the young lady.

units.source_text: 当然，我也没有特意在K面前表现过这层意思，K对这种事情本来就很迟钝。

en.t: Of course, I had not deliberately shown such feelings in front of K, and K was naturally dull about this sort of thing.

units.source_text: 当初，我正是因为K老实，可以让人放心，才特意把他带到这个家里来的。

en.t: In the beginning, it was precisely because K was honest and could be trusted that I had gone out of my way to bring him into this household.
